title: Independent Media Governance Ledger
problem: independent media operators need durable governance and provenance systems that prove editorial independence, ownership, and platform resilience over time.
direction: A governance ledger for media portfolios that tracks editorial policy versions, ownership/brand relationships, infrastructure dependencies, and public corrections as verifiable timelines.
why: W-World Media explicitly frames itself around independent media, platform ownership, transparency, governance, and long-term stewardship. The project gives that thesis an inspectable operating system.

archetypes.name: independent evidence replay
archetypes.trigger: independent signal changes while media context is stale
archetypes.expected: block release until cited evidence is regenerated

archetypes.name: media boundary probe
archetypes.trigger: media handoff crosses a policy or trust boundary
archetypes.expected: route to reviewer with evidence packet

archetypes.name: operators regression harness
archetypes.trigger: operators behavior regresses against the last accepted fixture
archetypes.expected: open a regression issue with trace and benchmark delta

archetypes.name: durable operator packet
archetypes.trigger: durable output needs a human-readable audit packet
archetypes.expected: accept only if decision claims cite fixture evidence
